# The Steak House on the Verandah — Comprehensive AI Knowledge Base

## Overview
The Steak House on the Verandah is Kingston, Jamaica's foremost fine dining steakhouse and culinary landmark. It is housed on the historic wraparound colonial verandah of Devon House, built in 1881 by George Stiebel, Jamaica's first black millionaire.

## Address & Contact
- **Physical Address**: 26 Hope Road, Devon House Mansion Verandah, Kingston 10, Jamaica, W.I.
- **Phone**: +1 (876) 616-8831 / +1 (876) 926-6867
- **Email**: reservations@steakhouseja.com
- **Website**: https://steakhouse-on-the-verandah.vercel.app/

## Culinary Highlights & Aging
- In-house 35 to 41-day dry-aging program inside Himalayan salt chambers.
- Flagship Kingston Signature Steak (KSS) with Blue Mountain espresso rub.
- Prime 38-day dry-aged bone-in ribeye, filet mignon with black winter truffle butter, 40-day tomahawk for two.
- Scotch bonnet roasted bone marrow with fresh herb gremolata and grilled brioche.
- Fresh Caribbean lobster, pan-seared red snapper over coconut callaloo risotto.
- Warm flourless dark chocolate cake with authentic Devon Stout ice cream.
- Curated sommelier cellar featuring 180+ global vintages and rare vintage Jamaican rums.

## Dining Hours
- Tuesday – Thursday: 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM (Lunch & Dinner)
- Friday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Dinner & Cellar Service)
- Sunday: 11:30 AM – 8:00 PM (Sunday Roasts & Family Dinners)
- Monday: Closed for private dining, weddings, and VIP events.
